title: Rewards
statementMd:
Bizon the Champion is called the Champion for a reason.

Bizon the Champion has recently got a present — a new glass cupboard with $*n*$ shelves and he decided to put all his presents there. All the presents can be divided into two types: medals and cups. Bizon the Champion has $*a*_{1}$ first prize cups, $*a*_{2}$ second prize cups and $*a*_{3}$ third prize cups. Besides, he has $*b*_{1}$ first prize medals, $*b*_{2}$ second prize medals and $*b*_{3}$ third prize medals.

Naturally, the rewards in the cupboard must look good, that's why Bizon the Champion decided to follow the rules:

- any shelf cannot contain both cups and medals at the same time;
- no shelf can contain more than five cups;
- no shelf can have more than ten medals.

Help Bizon the Champion find out if we can put all the rewards so that all the conditions are fulfilled.

## Input

The first line contains integers $*a*_{1}$, $*a*_{2}$ and $*a*_{3}$ $(0 ≤ *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3} ≤ 100)$. The second line contains integers $*b*_{1}$, $*b*_{2}$ and $*b*_{3}$ $(0 ≤ *b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, *b*_{3} ≤ 100)$. The third line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100)$.

The numbers in the lines are separated by single spaces.

## Output

Print "`YES`" (without the quotes) if all the rewards can be put on the shelves in the described manner. Otherwise, print "`NO`" (without the quotes).
statementZhMd:
Bizon the Champion 被称为 Champion 是有原因的。

最近，Bizon the Champion 收到了一件礼物——一个有 $*n*$ 层搁板的新玻璃柜，于是他决定把所有奖品都放进去。所有奖品可以分为两类：奖杯和奖牌。Bizon the Champion 有 $*a*_{1}$ 个一等奖奖杯、$*a*_{2}$ 个二等奖奖杯和 $*a*_{3}$ 个三等奖奖杯。此外，他还有 $*b*_{1}$ 个一等奖奖牌、$*b*_{2}$ 个二等奖奖牌和 $*b*_{3}$ 个三等奖奖牌。

当然，柜子里的奖品必须摆放得美观，因此 Bizon the Champion 决定遵守以下规则：

- 任何一层搁板上不能同时放置奖杯和奖牌；
- 每层搁板上最多放置五个奖杯；
- 每层搁板上最多放置十个奖牌。

请帮助 Bizon the Champion 判断是否可以在满足所有条件的情况下，将所有奖品放入搁板中。

## 输入格式

第一行包含整数 $*a*_{1}$、$*a*_{2}$ 和 $*a*_{3}$ $(0 ≤ *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, *a*_{3} ≤ 100)$。第二行包含整数 $*b*_{1}$、$*b*_{2}$ 和 $*b*_{3}$ $(0 ≤ *b*_{1}, *b*_{2}, *b*_{3} ≤ 100)$。第三行包含整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100)$。

每行中的数字由单个空格分隔。

## 输出格式

如果可以按照所述方式将所有奖品放入搁板中，输出 `YES`（不含引号）。否则，输出 `NO`（不含引号）。
